## Maintainer checklist

- [ ] This is maintainer-authored editorial work.
- [ ] Every changed lore entry has recorded provenance and publication approval.
- [ ] The change contains no private game material, spoilers, third-party
      material without permission, or unapproved assets.
- [ ] The copyright and canon boundaries remain accurate.
